title: Per-API-key rate limiting at the gateway
description:
We need a fixed-window rate limiter keyed by API key to stop a single integration from degrading the shared cluster. Limit: 100 requests per 60-second window per key. When exceeded, respond with HTTP 429 and a `Retry-After` header (seconds until the window resets). Use the existing Redis. The window must reset 60 seconds after the first request in it, regardless of traffic during the window.

Out of scope: per-endpoint limits, burst credits, dashboards.
environment: Node 20, TypeScript 5, Express 4, Redis 7 via ioredis. Service: gateway.
comments: security-eng: Last incident a single key sent 9k rps for 20 minutes.
sre: Redis commands must be cheap; this runs on every request, so avoid Lua unless needed.
backend-dev: INCR plus EXPIRE is enough for fixed window.
